verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only marketing-style feature claims (AI-powered summaries, live transcription, speaker recognition) with no vendor documentation of the transcription model(s) used, quantified accuracy benchmarks, or explicitly stated known limitations (e.g., accent/language performance, noise handling). Community evidence even flags real accuracy gaps (accents, non-English speech) that the vendor's own docs never acknowledge, reinforcing the absence of transparent quality documentation.
